title: Made in Abyss Music Pack
description: Replaces Minecraft's music and discs with the beautiful and atmospheric soundtrack from Made in Abyss by Kevin Penkin. Pack by kr1ssan.
body:
# Made in Abyss Music Pack (en)

Bring the breathtaking, beautiful, and sometimes terrifying atmosphere of the Abyss into your Minecraft world! This resource pack completely replaces the default in-game music and music discs with Kevin Penkin's soundtracks for the Made in Abyss anime. All tracks have been properly integrated into Minecraft.

## Tracklist

### Music Discs
- **Disc 13:** Hanezeve Caradhina (ft. Takeshi Saito)
- **Cat:** Gravity
- **Blocks:** VOH
- **Chirp:** reBirth (ft. Takeshi Saito)
- **Far:** The Girl with Curly Green Hair
- **Mall:** Narehate and the Machine
- **Mellohi:** reBirth; Arranged
- **Stal:** Tozo Hanoline
- **Strad:** Prushka Sequence
- **Ward:** Classroom
- **Disc 11:** Crucifixion
- **Wait:** Dark Reg, Nightmare Fuel
- **Pigstep:** I. AM. BURNING. MAN.
- **Otherside:** Reg & his Interference Unit
- **Disc 5:** Juroimoh Mutation
- **Relic:** Old Stories

## Dimensions & Biomes
- **Overworld & Caves:** 40 combined tracks playing across the surface and underground (Counterpoint, Days in the Sun, Faith, Faputa, Finale, Forest of the Abyss, Belaf's Lullaby, Discover the Abyss, Drums of Ganja, Market of Iruburu, Vueko, etc.)
- **The Nether:** Encounter the Umbra, Roar of the Abyss, Stingerhead Nest, Tasukete.
- **The End & Ender Dragon:** Juroimoh Mutation, Rumble of Scientific Triumph, San-Ken, Serpent Call, The Pit.
- **Deep Dark:** Dark Reg, Nanachi in the Dark.

---
- **Pack Creator:** kr1ssan
- **Music by:** Kevin Penkin & Made in Abyss creators.

# Made in Abyss Music Pack (ru)

Перенесите захватывающую, прекрасную, а местами пугающую атмосферу Бездны в свой мир Minecraft! Этот ресурс-пак полностью заменяет стандартную внутриигровую музыку и музыкальные пластинки на саундтреки Кевина Пенкина для аниме "Созданный В Бездне". Все треки были грамотно интегрированы в Minecraft.

## Список треков

### Музыкальные пластинки
- **Пластинка 13:** Hanezeve Caradhina (ft. Takeshi Saito)
- **Cat:** Gravity
- **Blocks:** VOH
- **Chirp:** reBirth (ft. Takeshi Saito)
- **Far:** The Girl with Curly Green Hair
- **Mall:** Narehate and the Machine
- **Mellohi:** reBirth; Arranged
- **Stal:** Tozo Hanoline
- **Strad:** Prushka Sequence
- **Ward:** Classroom
- **Пластинка 11:** Crucifixion
- **Wait:** Dark Reg, Nightmare Fuel
- **Pigstep:** I. AM. BURNING. MAN.
- **Otherside:** Reg & his Interference Unit
- **Пластинка 5:** Juroimoh Mutation
- **Relic:** Old Stories

## Измерения и биомы
- **Верхний мир и пещеры:** 40 объединенных треков, звучащих на поверхности и под землей (Counterpoint, Days in the Sun, Faith, Faputa, Finale, Forest of the Abyss, Belaf's Lullaby, Discover the Abyss, Drums of Ganja, Market of Iruburu, Vueko и др.)
- **Незер (Ад):** Encounter the Umbra, Roar of the Abyss, Stingerhead Nest, Tasukete.
- **Энд и Дракон Края:** Juroimoh Mutation, Rumble of Scientific Triumph, San-Ken, Serpent Call, The Pit.
- **Тёмные глубины (Deep Dark):** Dark Reg, Nanachi in the Dark.

---
- **Создатель пака:** kr1ssan
- **Автор музыки:** Kevin Penkin & Made in Abyss creators.
